evals.name: no-map-blocks
evals.prompt: /testing:refresh-feature-map. feature_map_dir resolves to the default .claude/skills/feature-map and that directory does not exist.
evals.expected_output: The outcome is blocked: no map exists at .claude/skills/feature-map. The report names /testing:map-features as the skill that writes one. No file is created.
expectations: Reports the outcome as blocked because no map exists
Names /testing:map-features to write the map
Creates no file

evals.name: skip-when-unchanged
evals.prompt: /testing:refresh-feature-map unattended. upkeep-skip.sh check printed `skip unchanged since the last clean pass`.
evals.expected_output: The unattended pass stops and reports the skip line. It dispatches no subagent, does not invoke /testing:run-e2e, edits nothing and opens no pull request.
expectations: Stops and reports the skip line
Does not invoke /testing:run-e2e
Edits no file and opens no pull request

evals.name: unattended-chrome-refused
evals.prompt: /testing:refresh-feature-map unattended. The map index at .claude/skills/feature-map/SKILL.md records `Driver: chrome, from docs/conventions/testing.yaml`, and upkeep-skip.sh check printed `run HEAD moved since the last clean pass`.
evals.expected_output: The outcome is blocked: an unattended pass never drives the host-brokered chrome driver. The report says the map needs a driver that runs inside the boundary, such as playwright, set by re-running /testing:map-features or editing the index. It does not switch to another driver on its own and drives nothing.
expectations: Reports the outcome as blocked because the driver is chrome and the pass is unattended
Does not switch to another driver on its own
Does not invoke /testing:run-e2e

evals.name: renamed-handle-corrected-in-map-only
evals.prompt: /testing:refresh-feature-map. The live pass shows the dashboard button the map's start-a-timer.md calls `Start` is now labelled `Begin`, and the timer still works through it. The source pass cites src/components/TimerRow.tsx:41 for the new label.
evals.expected_output: The outcome is changed. Only .claude/skills/feature-map/start-a-timer.md (and the index's written-at commit) is edited to use `Begin`; src/components/TimerRow.tsx is not touched. Because the pass is attended, the skill shows the proposed edit and asks before writing it, committing to feature-map-upkeep/claude-skills-feature-map or opening a pull request.
expectations: Edits start-a-timer.md to name the `Begin` button
Edits no file outside the map directory
Asks the person before committing or opening a pull request
Names the branch feature-map-upkeep/claude-skills-feature-map

evals.name: lost-behavior-reported-not-mapped
evals.prompt: /testing:refresh-feature-map. The map's weekly-timesheet-export.md lists a `Download CSV` entry point. Against a healthy app (the doctor passes), the button exists but the download now returns an empty file. The bugs plugin is enabled.
evals.expected_output: The export entry stays as written in the map; the map never records the empty download as current behavior. The failure is written up through /bugs:write with run-e2e's evidence. With no other difference the outcome is clean and the pass is recorded.
expectations: Leaves the Download CSV entry in weekly-timesheet-export.md unchanged
Writes the failure up through /bugs:write
Does not change any product file

evals.name: open-pr-updated-not-duplicated
evals.prompt: /testing:refresh-feature-map unattended. The pass found one stale trap in the map. The branch feature-map-upkeep/claude-skills-feature-map already exists and has an open pull request.
evals.expected_output: The correction is committed to feature-map-upkeep/claude-skills-feature-map (staging only the map file) and the branch is pushed, which updates the open pull request. No second pull request is opened. The report gives the branch, the commit and the existing pull request.
expectations: Commits on feature-map-upkeep/claude-skills-feature-map
Updates the existing pull request by pushing the branch
Opens no second pull request

evals.name: clean-pass-records
evals.prompt: /testing:refresh-feature-map. The source pass and the live pass both match every feature file, and the doctor passed.
evals.expected_output: The outcome is clean. Nothing is edited, no branch is created and no pull request is opened. The pass is recorded with upkeep-skip.sh record so the next pass skips until HEAD moves.
expectations: Reports the outcome as clean
Runs upkeep-skip.sh record
Creates no branch and opens no pull request

evals.name: driver-unavailable-writes-no-candidate
evals.prompt: /testing:refresh-feature-map unattended. The source pass found that the `Export` button in weekly-timesheet-export.md is now labelled `Download` (src/timesheet/Toolbar.tsx:42). The app builds and the doctor passes, but /testing:run-e2e stops with a gap report: the recorded playwright driver has no browser installed on this host.
evals.expected_output: The outcome is blocked: driver unavailable, with run-e2e's gap report. The Export-to-Download candidate is not written into the map, because no drive confirmed it; the report lists it with src/timesheet/Toolbar.tsx:42. No branch is created, nothing is committed, no pull request is opened, and the driver is not switched.
expectations: Reports the outcome as blocked: driver unavailable with the gap report
Leaves weekly-timesheet-export.md unchanged
Lists the candidate with src/timesheet/Toolbar.tsx:42 in the report
Creates no branch and opens no pull request

evals.name: working-tree-changed-during-source-pass
evals.prompt: /testing:refresh-feature-map. Before the source pass, git status --porcelain printed nothing. After the subagents returned, it prints ` M src/timesheet/Toolbar.tsx`.
evals.expected_output: The working tree changed during the source pass, so the outcome is blocked and the report names src/timesheet/Toolbar.tsx as the changed path. The live pass does not run, no map file is edited, nothing is reverted or committed, and no pull request is opened.
expectations: Reports the outcome as blocked
Names src/timesheet/Toolbar.tsx as the changed path
Edits no map file and opens no pull request

evals.name: untracked-map-committed-with-corrections
evals.prompt: /testing:refresh-feature-map unattended. /testing:map-features wrote the map at .claude/skills/feature-map and nobody committed it: `git ls-files -- .claude/skills/feature-map` prints nothing, and `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` prints only `??` lines for SKILL.md, start-a-timer.md and weekly-timesheet-export.md under .claude/skills/feature-map/. The live pass shows the `Start` button in start-a-timer.md is now labelled `Begin` (src/components/TimerRow.tsx:41). The branch feature-map-upkeep/claude-skills-feature-map does not exist.
evals.expected_output: The untracked map does not block the pass. The skill creates feature-map-upkeep/claude-skills-feature-map from the default branch, and the untracked map files move with the switch. It writes the `Begin` correction and the index's written-at commit, then stages SKILL.md, start-a-timer.md and weekly-timesheet-export.md by path and commits them in one commit with the correction, so `git status --porcelain -- .claude/skills/feature-map` prints nothing. No file outside the map directory is staged, and a pull request is opened from the branch.
expectations: Does not stop as blocked over the untracked map files
Commits every map file, the untracked weekly-timesheet-export.md included, on feature-map-upkeep/claude-skills-feature-map in the same commit as the `Begin` correction
Stages the map files by path and stages no file outside the map directory

evals.name: untracked-map-with-outside-change-blocked
evals.prompt: /testing:refresh-feature-map unattended. The map at .claude/skills/feature-map was never committed: `git ls-files -- .claude/skills/feature-map` prints nothing. `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` prints `??` lines for the map files under .claude/skills/feature-map/ and also ` M src/timesheet/Toolbar.tsx`. The live pass found that the `Export` button in weekly-timesheet-export.md is now labelled `Download`.
evals.expected_output: The outcome is blocked before any branch switch. The report names src/timesheet/Toolbar.tsx as the uncommitted change outside the map directory that blocks the pass, and says the untracked map files alone would not have blocked it. No branch is created or switched to, nothing is staged or committed, the Export-to-Download correction goes in the report unwritten, and no pull request is opened.
expectations: Names src/timesheet/Toolbar.tsx as the change outside the map directory that blocks the pass
Says the untracked map files are not what blocks the pass
Creates no branch, commits nothing and opens no pull request
